Plumbing Rough-In & Wall Preparation in Progress Behind a finished renovation is a lot of work that homeowners may never see. In this project, our team is working with exposed wall framing, plumbing lines, and utility connections before the wall is closed and the next phase of construction begins. At Antoniel Renovations, we pay close attention to these behind-the-wall details because they affect how well the finished space performs. Our work can include selective demolition, framing adjustments, plumbing and electrical coordination, wall preparation, insulation, drywall, and finish work. Taking the time to inspect existing conditions and coordinate utilities properly helps prevent problems once everything is covered. Work like this is often part of a larger home renovation, home addition, room addition, ADU, accessory dwelling unit, or in-law suite project. We are a licensed and insured general contractor with more than 35 years of experience serving homeowners in Worcester, Concord, and Littleton, MA.
